rv.q: Laurence Connor’s exuberant revival of his 2019 production earns its cheers.
Even after 53 years, Joseph remains a show with something for everyone – and a lot of what we all need right now: Joy!
It gleefully dispenses with any anxieties about dodgy cultural stereotyping – if it wants to dance like an Egyptian, it damn well will.
Jason Donovan’s turn cements a musical firing on all cylinders.
Laurence Connor’s buoyant revival of Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice’s Biblical musical charmed audiences back in 2019, and remains an absolute winner.
This is a show that exults in being nothing more extreme than very enjoyable.

cn.t: Lloyd Webber and Rice's buoyant biblical musical delivers a joyful, high-energy sugar rush that has audiences singing along. Connor's smooth revival fires on all cylinders with infectious charm and mischief.

vr.q: the whole revival felt very much like butlins
